# Regional Background — Northern Strait

The Northern Strait is a narrow, heavily used shipping channel between three states. The
Republic of Arkania holds the eastern coast and has circulated a draft charter placing transit
scheduling in Arkanian hands. Belvar is a distant power with regional security commitments and a
naval task group on station outside the Strait. Cestia is a small state whose economy depends on
grain exports through the channel and whose coalition government forbids foreign soldiers on its
soil.

Tensions over access rights have risen over the past year, though open conflict has so far been
avoided. This is a public background Resource for the T-051 scenario knowledge acceptance test;
it is available to every Actor and contains no privileged information.
